description: Client-side script for ERPNext Item doctype, managing form interactions, custom buttons, dialogs for variants, and query setups.

classes.name: erpnext.item
classes.description: Namespace for item-related functions and dialogs.

methods.name: setup_queries
methods.description: Sets up query filters for various link fields in the item form.

methods.name: show_single_variant_dialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog to create a single item variant based on attributes.

methods.name: show_multiple_variants_dialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog to create multiple item variants based on selected attributes.

methods.name: show_modal_for_manufacturers
methods.description: Shows a modal dialog to input manufacturer details and create a variant.

methods.name: toggle_attributes
methods.description: Enables or disables the attributes section based on item variant settings.

methods.name: make_dashboard
methods.description: Creates a stock dashboard for the item if applicable.

methods.name: edit_prices_button
methods.description: Adds a button to navigate to the item price list for editing.

methods.name: weight_to_validate
methods.description: Validates that weight units are specified if weight is entered.

methods.name: set_asset_naming_series
methods.description: Sets options for asset naming series if available.
